name: feature.consent.nodes
description: Consent feature node pack — gate/record nodes over the ctx.features.consent surface. check evaluates a subject's consent for a category; record MERGES a partial consent update from a run. The SAME enforcement helper Analytics/Email consume — one consent rule.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Consent: Check
nodes.description: Evaluates whether a subject has consented to a category (necessary/analytics/marketing, plus the marketing.email|sms|push|whatsapp specifics) over ctx.features.consent. A missing/blank subjectKey or an unrecognized category is a typed validation_error, never a fabricated verdict. Fail-closed when the tenant policy is opt-in; permissive when the consent feature is off. A READ: it re-executes on replay/fork — a gate verdict is live by design, never served from a historical run.

nodes.label: Consent: Record
nodes.description: Merges a subject's consent choices over ctx.features.consent (per-category, latest-wins). A missing/blank subjectKey, or a categories block with no recordable boolean, is a typed validation_error. A SIDE EFFECT: served from the recorded outcome on replay/fork so a historical run never re-merges its consent over current state (ADR 0657 D3).
